review_notes: I read the whole file. The main new concepts are the complexification of a continuous multilinear form on `ι → ℝ` (`ContinuousMultilinearMap.complexifyPi`), its termwise version for formal multilinear series, and the identity theorem on real points. I searched Mathlib for existing complexification or base-change constructions for multilinear maps, series or analytic functions. I used patterns such as `complexif`, `baseChange`, `extendScalars` and ℝ→ℂ multilinear maps. The only `complexif` hits were Clifford algebra, inner product space and distribution files, which are unrelated. I found no multilinear or formal-series scalar-extension construction in Mathlib that this file duplicates. Other declarations in the file use existing Mathlib API (`mkPiAlgebra`, `compContinuousLinearMap`, `HasFPowerSeriesAt.restrictScalars`) instead of building parallel versions. A complete search of Mathlib is not possible, so some uncertainty remains. I report no finding.
